Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of TXN.
We generated $10.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 11% to 17% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.85 per share.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $3.5 billion this quarter, representing 11% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 195 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
